### 💡 Intuition & Approach
Fit log-log width scaling slopes for forward activation RMS and backward update RMS to verify muP width-transfer stability.

### ⚡ Python Reference Implementation
```python
import numpy as np

def cs336_l11_mup_invariant_diagnostics(widths: list, rms_activations: list, rms_changes: list, tolerance: float = 0.2) -> dict:
    x = np.log(np.array(widths, dtype=float))
    s_act = float(np.polyfit(x, np.log(np.array(rms_activations, dtype=float)), 1)[0])
    s_chg = float(np.polyfit(x, np.log(np.array(rms_changes, dtype=float)), 1)[0])
    return {'act_rms_slope': round(s_act, 6), 'chg_rms_slope': round(s_chg, 6), 'is_mup_invariant': abs(s_act) <= tolerance and abs(s_chg) <= tolerance}
```
